dressCode: Any costume you like. It doesn't need to be elaborate.
expect: A Halloween social in the MPH for every delegate after the last committee session on Day one: music, dancing and time with your friends, then dinner together.
photoBooth: There's a photo booth at Social Night. Get a picture with your friends in your costumes.

faq.question: Do I have to wear a costume?
faq.answer: Any costume you like works, and a simple, everyday one is fine. It doesn't need to be elaborate.

faq.question: What time does it start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at 4:45 pm and finishes at 6:15 pm. Dinner follows until 7:15 pm.

faq.question: Can parents come?
faq.answer: No. Social Night is only for registered delegates, and delegates can't bring a guest.
